verdict.rationale: First-party docs show a guided workflow for generating a Convertible Note/Bridge Note (docs-21) within generative workflows executed on-platform (docs-19). The platform emails signers and supports in-platform e-signature (docs-22, docs-37), and executed documents are smart-linked to an auto-updating cap table (docs-8, docs-34). Scenario modeling of future rounds exists (docs-10), but nothing ties it to note or SAFE conversion. missing for 10: any evidence of SAFE creation, explicit modeling of conversion terms (cap, discount, interest) on the cap table, independent or hands-on corroboration.
